name: Disgruntled Diners

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 25 Intimidation check (trained) to threaten the ghostly guests into submission or DC 28 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt; two successes are required to disable it.
reset: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which Ilza is the only other creature present, then immediately resets.
routine: (1 action) On the haunt's initiative, the phantoms hurl ghostly food and real silverware through the room. All creatures other than Ilza who are in the area take 2d8+9 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save) from the sharp forks and knives being thrown about.

items.name: Any Excuse for a Food Fight
items.text:
Trigger Ilza attacks the PCs

---
Effect Upon seeing Ilza's anger, the guests rise up in a flurry of activity, their voices suddenly loud and startling. Every PC in area D6 must succeed at a DC 24 Will save save or become Off-Guard for the first round of combat. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Phantasmal diners begin hurling phantom food and very real, sharp cutlery in a dangerous food fight that targets intruders.
